name: Disable Mouse Acceleration
description: Turns off 'enhance pointer precision', so the cursor moves a fixed distance per unit of mouse movement regardless of how fast you flick. Essential for consistent aim in games and for anyone building muscle memory.

name: Enable Mouse Acceleration
description: Restores Windows' default 'enhance pointer precision' curve, which speeds the cursor up as you move the mouse faster.

name: Fastest Keyboard Repeat Rate
description: Sets the shortest repeat delay and the fastest repeat rate, so a held-down key starts repeating sooner and moves faster. Noticeable when navigating text with the arrow keys.

name: Default Keyboard Repeat Rate
description: Puts the keyboard repeat delay and rate back to the Windows defaults.

name: Disable the Sticky Keys Prompt
description: Stops the dialog that appears when Shift is pressed five times. Sticky Keys itself can still be turned on from Settings.

name: Disable the Filter Keys Prompt
description: Stops the dialog that appears when the right Shift key is held for eight seconds.

name: Disable the Toggle Keys Prompt
description: Stops the dialog that appears when Num Lock is held for five seconds.

name: Increase the Mouse Input Queue
description: Raises the mouse driver's buffered-packet count from 100 to 200. Helps a high-polling-rate gaming mouse avoid dropped packets when the system is busy; costs a few kilobytes of non-paged pool.

name: Increase the Keyboard Input Queue
description: Raises the keyboard driver's buffered-packet count from 100 to 200, which helps with dropped keystrokes on a heavily loaded machine.

name: Scroll Inactive Windows on Hover
description: Lets the scroll wheel act on whatever window the pointer is over, without clicking it first.

name: Scroll Only the Focused Window
description: Sends wheel events to the active window regardless of where the pointer is, which is the classic behaviour.

name: Scroll Three Lines Per Wheel Notch
description: Sets the standard three-line scroll step, undoing a driver or app that has changed it.

name: Remove the Menu Open Delay
description: Drops the delay before a submenu opens from 400 ms to nothing, which is the single biggest perceived-responsiveness change in the Windows shell.

name: Restore the Default Menu Open Delay
description: Puts the submenu open delay back to the Windows default of 400 ms.

name: Disable the Touchpad When a Mouse Is Connected
description: Turns the precision touchpad off automatically while an external mouse is plugged in, which stops palm brushes moving the cursor.

name: Keep the Touchpad Active With a Mouse Connected
description: Leaves the precision touchpad usable even when an external mouse is attached.

name: Disable Tap-to-Click
description: Requires a real click on the precision touchpad instead of registering a light tap, which is the usual cure for a cursor that jumps mid-sentence.

name: Disable Pen Flicks
description: Turns off the gesture that converts a quick pen stroke into a navigation command, which frequently fires by accident while drawing.

name: Disable Pen and Touch Visual Feedback
description: Removes the ripple circles Windows draws at each touch or pen contact point.

name: Stop the Touch Keyboard Popping Up Automatically
description: Prevents the on-screen keyboard appearing whenever a text box gets focus on a touchscreen device with a physical keyboard attached.

name: Disable Hardware Keyboard Text Prediction
description: Turns off the suggestion strip Windows shows while typing on a physical keyboard, which also stops what you type being fed to the prediction model.

name: Disable Autocorrect for Misspelled Words
description: Stops Windows silently rewriting words as you type in touch-keyboard-aware apps.

name: Disable the Language Switch Hotkey
description: Turns off Left Alt + Shift and Ctrl + Shift as keyboard-layout switches. Stops a stray shortcut silently swapping your layout to another language mid-sentence.

name: Use a Separate Input Language Per Window
description: Lets each app remember its own keyboard layout, so switching to your terminal does not change the layout in your editor.

name: Turn Num Lock Off at Sign-In
description: Leaves Num Lock off on the sign-in screen, which matters on laptops where the numeric keypad overlaps the letter keys.

name: Stop the Text Cursor Blinking
description: Makes the text caret solid instead of blinking, which some people find much easier to track.

name: Disable Window Snapping by Dragging
description: Stops windows maximising or half-tiling when dragged to a screen edge. Win+arrow snapping is unaffected.

name: Disable the System Beep
description: Silences the console beep driver, which is what produces the sharp tone from the motherboard speaker on an invalid keystroke.
